text: {"claims":[{"claim_text":"In WAL mode, multiple writers can append to the WAL file at the same time.","verdict":"CONTRADICTED","reasoning":"Passage [0] states that there can only be one writer at a time, which directly refutes the claim that multiple writers can append simultaneously.","citations":[{"index":0,"quote":"However, since there is only one WAL file, there can only be one writer at a time."}]},{"claim_text":"A checkpoint is run automatically once the WAL file reaches 1000 pages.","verdict":"SUPPORTED","reasoning":"Passage [2] states that by default SQLite automatically runs a checkpoint when the WAL file reaches a threshold size of 1000 pages.","citations":[{"index":2,"quote":"By default, SQLite does a checkpoint automatically when the WAL file reaches a threshold size of 1000 pages."}]}]}
